name: week
title: The week
subtitle: Salon for Claude Code: what needs a decision and the book ahead, rendered by npm run view

sections.title: Needs a decision
sections.note: Worst first. A client booked for colour without a valid patch test outranks everything.
sections.sql: select reason, label, who, place, detail from v_attention order by rank, days desc nulls last limit 15

sections.title: The book, next seven days
sections.sql: select to_char(on_date, 'Dy DD Mon') as day, to_char(on_date + starts_at, 'HH24:MI') as starts, staff as chair, client, services, round(total_cents / 100.0, 2) as price_nzd, state from v_appointments where on_date >= current_date and on_date < current_date + 7 and status = 'booked' order by on_date, starts_at

sections.title: The empty chair
sections.note: Open hours per chair per day. The recall list is who to call.
sections.sql: select to_char(on_date, 'Dy DD Mon') as day, staff as chair, round(booked_minutes / 60.0, 1) as booked_hours, round(free_minutes / 60.0, 1) as open_hours from v_gaps where on_date >= current_date order by on_date, staff

name: money
title: The money
subtitle: Salon for Claude Code: takings, rebooking and the client risks, rendered by npm run view

sections.title: Takings, last seven days
sections.sql: select staff as chair, sum(visits)::int as visits, round(sum(service_cents) / 100.0, 2) as services_nzd, sum(retail_units)::int as retail_units, round(sum(retail_cents) / 100.0, 2) as retail_nzd from v_takings where on_date > current_date - 7 and on_date <= current_date group by staff order by sum(service_cents) + sum(retail_cents) desc

sections.title: Rebooking, last 28 days
sections.note: Who leaves holding their next appointment. The number a salon lives or dies on.
sections.sql: select staff as chair, visits, rebooked, rate_pct from v_rebooking order by rate_pct desc

sections.title: The recall list
sections.note: Lapsed clients, worth the most first. Opted in gets the recall draft; the rest get a personal call (UEMA 2007).
sections.sql: select name as client, to_char(last_visit_on, 'DD Mon') as last_in, days_since_visit as quiet_days, usual_gap_days, round(spend_cents_12m / 100.0, 2) as spend_12m_nzd, case when marketing_opt_in then 'yes' else 'call only' end as recall_ok from v_lapsed

sections.title: Voucher liability and low stock
sections.sql: select 'voucher ' || ref as item, coalesce(recipient, '') as who, round(balance_cents / 100.0, 2) as value_nzd, state from v_vouchers where balance_cents > 0 union all select name, kind, stock_on_hand, 'reorder at ' || reorder_level from v_stock_low
